headline.purpose: Fixed-size task identity for product screens.

data.purpose: Identifiers, counts, values, versions, and timestamps.

shadows.name: raised-overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, and toasts that sit physically above the workspace.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: The single dominant action in a task region.

shadows.name: surface-rest
shadows.purpose: Barely separates the primary data plane from the mineral canvas.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Press, hover, focus, and compact control state changes.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Drawers, menus, and occasional state reveals.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Responsive exponential ease-out for interface state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a task region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #1f5bd8; color: #fff; font: 650 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, transparent 78%); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, black 8%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, transparent 70%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded neutral action for secondary or reversible work.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #d7dde5; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font: 650 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #b9c3d0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, transparent 70%); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A white, structurally bounded field for filtering operational data.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-4-4"/></svg><input placeholder="Search repositories" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #d7dde5; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; color: #5f6b7d; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, white 18%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, transparent 70%); } .ds-search input { width: 280px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #111827; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Solid cobalt selection inside the graphite product rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 224px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #1f5bd8; color: #fff; font: 650 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, transparent 72%); } .ds-nav-active small { margin-left: auto; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, white, transparent 82%); color: white; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1f5bd8, black 8%); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, white, transparent 30%); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic state with a haloed dot and plain text.
components.css: .ds-state-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #168a4b; font: 600 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state-success::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, currentColor, transparent 88%); }

components.name: Operational Summary
components.description: A divided ledger band for real repository, run, and approval counts.
components.css: .ds-summary { border: 1px solid #d7dde5; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; background: #fff; } .ds-summary > div { padding: 16px 20px; display: grid; gap: 1px; } .ds-summary > div + div { border-left: 1px solid #d7dde5; } .ds-summary strong { color: #111827; font: 600 20px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-summary small { color: #5f6b7d; font: 400 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Attention Queue
components.description: An exception-led policy surface exposing the repository, workflow, exact subject, risk, and direct review action.
components.css: .ds-attention { padding: 16px 20px; border: 1px solid #d7dde5; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(230px, 1fr) 52px auto; align-items: center; gap: 20px; background: #fff; color: #111827; } .ds-attention small { display: block; color: #5f6b7d; font: 600 11px/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-attention b { font: 600 20px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
Runtrue feels like a trust console built around one verifiable journey: authenticated GitHub event, bounded workflow plan, exact policy decision, fenced runner execution, and durable evidence. The default view is exception-led so daily operators see blocked work first while evaluators can understand the product's distinctive control model from real interface material.

The system rejects decorative dashboard chrome and instead uses continuous data planes, structural rules, restrained typography, and one action color. Familiar controls disappear into the task; status colors appear only when the underlying state earns them.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite navigation anchors the product without turning the workspace into dark mode.
Mineral-gray canvas separates the application shell from white operational data planes.
Cobalt marks current location, primary action, and selected state only.
Tabular metadata and compact status language make live control-plane state easy to compare.
The default view explains the product through real decisions, source-linked runs, and strictly evidence-backed posture.
Motion is crisp, state-led, and reduced or removed for frequent interactions.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means action or selection; green, amber, and red mean real backend state. None are decoration.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: A surface uses either a structural border or an elevation shadow at rest, never both.

rules.name: The Operator Scale Rule
rules.body: Type establishes scan order without becoming a spectacle; page headings are the largest text in the product.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Tables and administration panels sit on the canvas with one structural boundary. Elevation appears only when an element actually moves above the workspace.

dos: Do let real repository, run, approval, runner, and policy state drive emphasis.
Do keep one clear primary action in each task region.
Do use the system sans for product UI and monospace only for comparable technical data.
Do preserve visible focus, 44px touch targets, reduced motion, and explicit empty/error/loading states.
Do keep responsive changes structural: collapse navigation and columns before shrinking type.
donts: Don't introduce decorative charts, gradients, glass, glow, or metric-card grids.
Don't use cobalt as ornament or semantic colors for non-state decoration.
Don't round every element into a pill or nest bordered cards inside bordered cards.
Don't add motion to frequent navigation, search, filtering, or keyboard-driven actions.
Don't invent repository health, workflow capability, commercial claims, or operational evidence.
